audit.why: Lane difficulty is stated as EVEN/skill through levels 1-5, tilting to Zilean late via Chronoshift + Time Warp kiting — matches both kits (no hard engage tool on Zilean, no sustain on Bard) and the packet's 47.42% WR / level chart (Skill x6, Zilean at late).

Spikes correctly flag Zilean's double-bomb at Lvl2 (Q cd 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, bomb detonates in 3s and stuns if double-stacked), Chronoshift at 6 (R cd 120/90/60), and Lost Chapter cooldown scaling into late Time Warp kiting.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Chronoshift as the punishable cooldown but never states its actual cooldown number, and mislabels Bard's own E (Magical Journey) as if it were a Zilean ability to track, which is confusing in a field meant to teach the enemy's cooldown windows.
audit.why: lintFindings flags COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT on breakdown.cooldowns. Zilean's kit gives real numbers: Chronoshift 120/90/60s, Time Warp (E) only 15s flat, Time Bomb (Q) 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s. Naming Bard's own Magical Journey here (instead of a Zilean cooldown) doesn't teach the enemy's punish windows.
audit.corrected: Cite Chronoshift's real per-rank cooldown, and swap the mid-bullet to Zilean's Time Warp (15s CD, not a long bank window) so all three bullets describe Zilean's kit.

edits.before: - Zilean Chronoshift: matchup-defining — The revive undoes your kill — force it early or swap focus when it glows. It writes your spacing rules. - E Magical Journey is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Chronoshift (R): 120/90/60s CD — the revive undoes your kill; force it early or swap focus when it glows. It writes your spacing rules. - Time Warp (E) is only a 15s CD, so don't expect a long bank window. - Time Bomb (Q) resets in 10-8s, funding double-stuns.

edits.after: Drop the shrine on your carry after every chip trade — it heals the poke back and outraces Zilean's own sustain-less kit.
